Virtual Assistant

Become a World-Class Virtual Assistant

Work From Anywhere while supporting businesses everywhere.  Launch a flexible, global career as a professional virtual assistant.

Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Beginner Friendly

No prior experience required.

Job Placement Support

Launch your career with internships and job placements.

Flexible Learning

Choose to learn at a pace that fits your schedule.

World-Class Tutors & Mentorship

Learn directly from industry experts.

Certificate

Earn a recognised certificate.

Download Course Brochure & Curriculum

Course Overview

The Virtual Assistant course prepares students to provide high-quality administrative, business, and creative support to clients and organizations remotely.
You’ll gain the essential digital, organizational, and communication skills required to excel as a professional virtual assistant in today’s remote-first economy.

From managing calendars and emails to using digital tools for productivity, this course equips you to confidently take on freelance or full-time VA roles across industries.

Learning Outcome

  1. Understand the core responsibilities and expectations of professional virtual assistants.
  2. Use essential productivity tools like Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and project management apps such as Trello, Asana, and Slack.
  3. Manage client communication, scheduling, invoicing, and reporting with professionalism.
  4. Build a personal brand, find clients, and grow your VA career through online platforms and business management strategies.

Next Cohort Starts
October 31st 2026

Duration: 2 months
Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Career Opportunities

  1. United States – $45,000 – $70,000 USD
  2. United Kingdom – £30,000 – £50,000 GBP
  3. Canada – $40,000 – $65,000 CAD
  4. Germany – €35,000 – €55,000 EUR
  5. Nigeria – ₦2.5 million – ₦4.5 million NGN
  6. Kenya – KSh 1.5 million – KSh 2.8 million KES
  7. Remote/Global Roles – $35,000 – $60,000 USD

Career Pathways

  1. Executive Virtual Assistant
  2. Administrative Virtual Assistant
  3. Customer Support Specialist
  4. Project Coordination Assistant
  5. Freelance Virtual Assistant / Entrepreneur

Salary Trend

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a Virtual Assistant in 3-6 Months.

Module 1 - Introduction to the Virtual Assistant Profession
  • Who is a Virtual Assistant?
  • Misconceptions About Virtual Assistants.
  • Overview of the virtual assistance field, remote work opportunities, and VA roles.
  • Why Become a VA?
  • Exercise
Module 2 - Skills Self-Assessment & Growth Plan
  • The 3 Core Skill Categories:
  • Soft Skills (communication, time management, adaptability, etc.)
  • Hard Skills (research, writing, data entry, customer support)
  • Professional communication, time management, and file organization.
Module 3 - Tools for Virtual Assistance
  • Productivity: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365
  • Communication: Slack, Zoom, Notion, Asana, Trello
  • Document management and scheduling tools
Module 4 - Client Communication & Task Management
  • Structuring workflow, multiple clients, and using productivity systems
  • Handling emails, appointments, and calls
  • Writing professional messages and reports
  • Organizing tasks and prioritizing work
  • Exercise
Module 5 - AI, Social Media & Content Management
  • Creating, scheduling, and managing content Canva.
  • AI & Virtual Assistants
  • Project management systems (ClickUp, Asana) and AI tools (ChatGPT, Otter.ai).
Module 6 - Email Calendar Management
  • Inbox organization
  • Calendar management
Module 7 - Research, Reporting & Documentation
  • Conducting research, preparing reports, and presenting updates
    effectively
  • Calendar management
Module 8 - Branding & Career Growth as a Virtual Assistant
  • Creating a professional online profile and portfolio
  • Finding clients on Upwork, Fiverr, and LinkedIn
  • Building long-term client relationships

Frequently Asked Questions

I don’t have a tech background.
70% of our graduates started with zero tech experiences. Our beginner-friendly approach starts with basics and builds progressively
I can’t afford it
Up to 50-100% scholarship coverage available. You only pay registration and certification fees upfront.
I don't have time
Flexible learning schedules including evenings and weekends. Complete the program while maintaining your current job.
Will I actually get a job?
Guaranteed internship placement + access to exclusive job board with 500+ partner companies actively hiring our graduates
